New CAT Court Complex Inaugurated in Jammu by Union Minister

Union Minister Dr. Jitendra Singh inaugurated a new court complex for the Central Administrative Tribunal (CAT) in Jammu. He stated that the Jammu bench of the CAT has disposed of the highest number of service cases in the country.
